judgments.reason: Hoffmann et al. 2007 paper reports the EPFL P300 BCI recordings from 8 subjects (4 disabled, 4 able-bodied); authors and DOI match the dataset's source publication.
judgments.paper_title: An efficient P300-based brain–computer interface for disabled subjects

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing data into BIDS, used to format this dataset; it is not a paper describing the Hoffmann 2008 P300 data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification extension used to format the dataset, not a paper describing the Hoffmann 2008 P300 data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
